evals.prompt: Define success metrics and the tracking plan for a new 'round-up savings' feature in our banking app. Our events use object_action naming.
evals.expected_output: A measurement plan with one outcome metric (for example share of eligible active users with round-up enabled after 30 days), input metrics, guardrails such as disable rate and support contacts, precise definitions, a tracking table with object_action events, no personal data in properties, and a read-out plan.
assertions: Exactly one outcome metric is defined
Event properties exclude personal data such as amounts tied to identity or IBAN
